elements.texte:
[cheerful] The cast function converts a value to another type.

We write the value, then the type we want after as: here integer, an integer.

Cast converts the text 1002481 into the integer 1002481: the digits stay the same, only the type changes.

Applied to the full reference, cast returns 0,

Because the text starts with C-M-D dash, not with digits.

The text starts with letters: cast returns 0, without showing an error message.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Every value has a type that says what kind it is:

Integer for integers, real for decimal numbers and text for text.

For example, 34 is an integer, 29.9 a decimal number

And C-M-D, dash, 2026, dash, 1002481 is text, written between quotes.

Cast price as integer drops the decimals, without rounding: 29.9 becomes 29.
